solutions.explanationMarkdown: Use two pointers over a mutable character array. Skip nonletters on both sides, then swap the next pair of ASCII letters. Each pointer moves only toward the center.
solutions.complexityNotes: n counts Unicode codepoints. Python strings are immutable, so the mutable buffer and returned string require linear storage.

solutions.source: let mirrorLetters text = let a=Bytes.of_string text in let letter c = c>='a' && c<='z' || c>='A' && c<='Z' in let l=ref 0 and r=ref (Bytes.length a-1) in while !l < !r do if not (letter (Bytes.get a !l)) then incr l else if not (letter (Bytes.get a !r)) then decr r else (let c=Bytes.get a !l in Bytes.set a !l (Bytes.get a !r);Bytes.set a !r c;incr l;decr r) done;Bytes.to_string a
